planning.title: Wedding planning tool
planning.subtitle: Build a personal checklist, tick off what's done, and keep everything in one place — from the venue to the cake.
planning.feature1: A ready-made checklist based on Georgian wedding norms
planning.feature3: Saved to your account — on any device
planning.heroSubtitle: Getting married? We’ll guide you through every detail, month by month — for free.
planning.coveredTitle: Our free checklist has you covered
planning.coveredText: We’ll help you plan and get that “check, check, check” satisfaction.
planning.easyText: Personalize your checklist — add your own tasks and track your progress, your way.
planning.oneSpotText: From local vendors to staying on budget, our free tools work together to make planning easier.
planning.vendorCardText: Browse and shortlist photographers, venues, decorators and more.
planning.estimateCardText: See a recommended split across categories based on Georgian wedding norms.
planning.tipsText: What should you tackle first? How do you split your budget? We have answers.
planning.faq1q: What are the basics of wedding planning?
planning.faq1a: Wedding planning is different for every couple. Our free checklist offers detailed month-by-month suggestions and is fully customizable to your own timeline.
planning.faq2q: What is the first thing to do when planning a wedding?
planning.faq2a: Start by setting your budget and a rough guest count — it makes many later decisions much easier.
planning.faq3q: How long does it take to plan a wedding?
planning.faq3a: Typically 10–16 months, though it can range from a few weeks to years depending on the type of wedding.
planning.finalTitle: Learn what to do and when
planning.finalText: Stay on top of every little thing — our free checklist has you covered.
